team.name: Data Czars
team.mission: We build and support the tooling that keeps the Contoso Analytics Environment fast, safe and easy to use.
team.pae: The Contoso Analytics Environment: the shared workspaces, data and reports the analytics teams build on.
team.audience: Analysts, report builders and data engineers who work in the analytics environment.
team.officeHours: Thursdays, 2:00 to 3:00 PM, in the team's Teams channel

products.name: Refresh Monitor
products.summary: Watches every scheduled refresh in the environment and says which ones failed and why.
products.howToStart: Open the Refresh Monitor report from the Links page.

products.name: Workspace Inventory
products.summary: Lists every workspace, its owners and what it holds, so nothing in the environment is orphaned.

usageTool.name: Usage Tool
usageTool.summary: Counts who uses which reports and workspaces, and publishes the monthly usage reports.
howItWorks: Reads the environment's activity log once a day.
Rolls the activity up by report, workspace and team.
Writes one workbook per report type at the start of each month.

reportTypes.name: Workspace activity
reportTypes.description: Active users and refreshes per workspace.

usageTool.schedule: On the first working day of each month.
usageTool.outputLocation: A folder on the operator's laptop today.

fleet.summary: Several agents, one per repository, watched and answered from one window; data-czars and usage_tool are two of them.

links.title: Data Czars Jira board
links.description: Every ticket the team is working on.

releases.headline: Failed refreshes now name the data source that failed

faq.question: Where do I report a broken refresh?
faq.answer: Get help > Report an issue, product Refresh Monitor. It becomes a Jira ticket on our board.
